name: ACCEL-KS
evidence: Statewide ACCEL-KS accelerator (run by the Kansas Dept. of Commerce; KU Innovation Park runs the Lawrence track and Groover Labs the Wichita track as host LPs). Has its OWN Dealroom entity (accel_ks, labelled 'Accelerator', HQ Lawrence, launched 2025). Both inaugural 2026 cohorts worked this pass: 16 alumni companies now in the ACCEL-KS portfolio (9 newly created + 7 existing profiles linked), all attached via SUPPORT PROGRAM rounds and verified. NOTE: KU Innovation Park (an INCUBATOR, ~58 legacy tenants) and Groover Labs (a coworking nonprofit) are host LPs, NOT the accelerator — the original Kansas frame mis-mapped them, since corrected.
